Fractional CTO and technical advisory

Make the right technical decisions without hiring a CTO: architecture, contractors, budget and team. Basic plan: UZS 18–36.5 mln / per month.

What you get

Basic plan
  • Basic plan, 2–4 hours a week: architecture decisions, reviews of vendor estimates, hiring help, a monthly tech report to the owner
Extended plan
  • Extended plan, 1–2 days a week: roadmap and budget, team leadership, oversight of security and compliance, preparation for investor technical due diligence

Questions

What does “Fractional CTO and technical advisory” cost?
The MVP costs $1,500–3,000 (UZS 18–36.5 mln), the full version $4,000–8,000 (UZS 48–97 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Fractional CTO and technical advisory” take?
The MVP takes 1–2 weeks, the full version 2–4 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
The project's code and documents; Access rights; A contact person.
